answer: The design leans on per-epoch sampling audit, clawed back after a replayed submission, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. The walnut lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the echo is where a second reviewer recomputes them. Reaching the pulse of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name.
